evidence.reason: AE-08 phase 8 step 11d integration (11d A-E and A2 on 11c, plus d72a7d08 and a settling fix to one HT witness). Every arm anchored in or witnessed by the touched files (609 anchored and 126 witness-only live arms, controls as dependencies) was run one at a time with --only --jobs 1; the gates f-controller (667/1/0 judged unchanged), rc1-g-controller, rc1-i6-desktop and f-hookwit passed. (1) Re-pointed, 19 arms whose `from` anchor 11d moved in useTimelinePlayback.ts: ledger:457:mutant:{b6f,hookwit,playback} and ledger:466:mutant:{b6f,b6f2,b6f3,playback} (the post-prepare block now sets `nativePreviewCompiledFingerprint` and calls `adoptEditsPastBaseline()`; the mutation still drops the portable fallback and sets the baseline only when the preview started), ledger:459:mutant:{b6f,hookwit,playback} (`desiredAtStart` now sits between `seekSequence` and `commitPortableStart`), ledger:470:mutant:{b6f,b6f2,b6f3} (the block now ends in `adoptEditsPastBaseline()`), ledger:477:mutant:{b6f5,matrix,playback} (the portable-browser baseline now reads `desiredAtStart`), ledger:482:mutant:{b6f5,matrix,playback} (the effect's own `requestTimelineSchedule` is gone; the mutation drops `followPortableEdits()` from the playing branch). Each live one is still killed with its recorded failing names, run alone with --only: 457:b6f, 457:playback, 459:b6f/hookwit/playback, 466:b6f/b6f3/playback, 477:b6f5/matrix/playback, 482:b6f5/matrix/playback. 457:hookwit, 466:b6f2 and 470:b6f/b6f2/b6f3 are recorded survivors that tiers.ts already retires (exit 0, nothing failing); only their anchors move. (2) Retired: none. No arm's code was deleted: `timeline-schedule-replaced`, `audio-source-hydration-pending` and `native-paused-adoption-failure` are held by no arm and the first two by no source line. (3) Killer rename: 11d A renamed the two B6d7 tests `schedule-replacement dispose` -> `project-switch dispose` (same assertions, different dispose held). The failing names move for the 10 arms whose observed set is exactly the recorded set with that rename: rc2:421:1, 428:1, 436:0, 436:1, 436:2 and diag:419:419-plus-428, 419:419-plus-436, 428:428-repeat, 434:434-plus-436-playback, 434:436-alone-playback. Counts stay recorded (the judge takes counts as notes and compares the control delta). (4) Witness repaired in the 11d integration commit: the B6f5 rename test read the preview as settled while its start was still pending, so the rename landed in 11d B's keep-while-preparing window and the mutant (track name in the fingerprint) survived; with the settling turns it fails ledger:492:mutant:{playback,step5b} and 493:mutant:step5b as recorded, so those arms keep their records. (5) Not changed, fail until the parent rules: 12 arms whose killers narrowed. rc2:427:1 and diag 418:418-plus-427-playback, 418:427-alone-playback, 419:419-plus-427, 419:427-alone lose the B6d7 begin-released-first killer (22 of 23 remain, the other B6d7 killer renamed); ledger:468:mutant:playback loses B6f4 re-run and W-UD7p-2 and gains C9e W-C9-track-11; 468:b6f4 and 469:b6f4 keep 1 of 2; 469:playback keeps 17 of 49; 470:playback keeps 2 of 3; 469:b6f3 and 470:b6f4 now survive (exit 0). No retirement: their code is live. No watched hash moves here. For --full: manifest and fuzz-source hashes of useTimelinePlayback.ts, useTimelinePlayback.test.ts, native-playback-controller.ts and its test, Timeline.tsx, vst-instance-failures.ts, timeline-source-test-support.ts, live-native-projection.ts and native-spool-wav.test.ts (pinned at 57807ade); the g-tools-typecheck record (17 recorded diagnostics, 15 now: both native-spool-wav.test.ts TS2339 'offset' entries were fixed by 311548c3; tools/tsc-baseline.txt stays at 101 and `bun tools/typecheck.ts` passes); the HT and C test pass counts; and the seeds:hook shard failures that already fail at HEAD.
